'''Varrow''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Dread Host]] who held the position of Dread Guardsman during the [[Galactic War]]. He led a [[Raid on the Arcanum|raid]] on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] ''[[Arcanum]]'' facility, wreaking havoc and also stealing the powerful [[Darkstaff]]. He fled to [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], but was ultimately defeated in battle, causing the Darkstaff to vanish into thin air.
